negative_results: A residual whose peak amplitude is within the combined-uncertainty coverage (k*u) is classified NOISE_WITHIN_UNCERTAINTY, not anomalous.
Attacks lacking their required context are recorded as applicable=false and never fire; failed and inapplicable explanations are preserved in the battery, not dropped.
refuse_residual_before_attacks([]) and (None) raise OrdinaryExplanationError: the UNEXPLAINED label cannot precede the attack battery.
refuse_residual_as_new_physics raises ClaimError: an UNEXPLAINED_INSTRUMENT_RESIDUAL is never new physics.
No apparatus was operated and nothing was measured; every fixture is a seeded synthetic waveform.
reopening_test: If a residual is claimed UNEXPLAINED_INSTRUMENT_RESIDUAL, re-run run_all_attacks with the full acquisition context (raw artifact, clock/timebase, calibration reference, environment and aggressor channels, blank-fixture record, declared specimen band, and model prediction); any newly-available ordinary explanation that fires reopens the classification and demotes it out of the ceiling. Independent replication on a different apparatus and operator is required before it is anything more than the ceiling.

claims.statement: The ordinary-explanation firewall is implemented as eleven attack detectors plus a union classifier over a candidate residual.

The strongest label any residual reaches here is UNEXPLAINED_INSTRUMENT_RESIDUAL, the ceiling for an unreplicated residual that survived the attacks. It is never a resonance, a particle, a new energy, or new physics.
